pins.title: Animal tracks for kids: read a footprint trail in soft ground
pins.description: What can we record if the animal has already gone? Look at the direction of its tracks and sketch one print without disturbing it. Record the date and weather beside the sketch, then compare the same patch over five days. Get the free Nature Tracker with an adult email.
pins.alt: Bird tracks lead past a pale stone on a damp woodland path.

pins.title: Rock pool activity for kids: count the kinds of life in one pool
pins.description: How do we explore a rock pool without disturbing it? At low tide, watch from a safe spot with a grown-up and count the different kinds of life you can see. Leave rocks and animals where they are. Compare your count with a second pool. Try the free Rock-Pool Census.
